# Fuel Performance Summary

## UO2 Properties
### Lattice and Density
The lattice constant of UO2 is 5.4704 angstrom with density 10.97 g/cm^3.
### Thermal Properties
The thermal conductivity at 300 K is 8.0 W/(m K). The melting point is 3120 K.
#### High-Temperature Degradation
At 2000 K, thermal conductivity drops to 2.0 W/(m K). The specific heat at 1500 K is 0.340 J/(g K). The bulk modulus is 207.5 GPa.
